column1: WHEREAS the office of return member of Thumpane Pradeshiya Sabha has fallen vacant by reason of Death;
And whereas the secretary of the United National Alliance the recognized political party to which Bishrul Amjat
Muthalib the member belonged, was required by me under section 66A (I) of the aforesaid ordinance, to decide upon returned
member  of Thumpane  Pradeshiya  Sabha  who  belongs  to  such  party  and  is  not  disqualified  under  section  9  of  the  local
authorities elections ordinance (Chapter 262) and who shall be declared selected as a member within a period of thirty (30)
And whereas the secretary of the aforesaid recognized political party has communicated his decision to nominate
Seyyadu Ahamed Mohamad Rimsad to fill such vacancy;
Therefore I, Hewage Dhanushka Naleen Sampath Fernando, returning officer of the Thumpane Pradeshiya Sabha
acting in terms of section 66A (I) of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance (Chapter 262) do hereby declare that Seyyadu
Ahamed Mohamad Rimsad. was selected as the member of the Thumpane Pradeshiya Sabha.
